policy: A trustworthy official government consolidated text or clearly identified official page may be accepted as an external reference within its displayed status, version, language, date and subject. If authority, version or content is unclear, offer the whole official government website/service for human review. A human-reviewed link is sufficient for ordinary source use; a local copy, custom retrieval/conversion rule, API, full Gazette amendment chain, hash, replay or scheduled update is not a blanket prerequisite. External-link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, issue/topic coverage and country review completion.
